question: The Olympic Winter Games 2026 will be played in_______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Milano Cortina**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The 2026 Winter Olympics, **also known as **Milano-Cortina 2026,** is an upcoming international multi-sport event slated to occur from February 6 to February 22, 2026, in the Italian cities of Milan and Cortina d'Ampezzo.
 
• The joint bid from these two cities secured victory over another joint bid from **Swedish cities Stockholm–Åre **by a vote of **47–34** at the 134th Session of the **International Olympic Committee (IOC) in Lausanne,** Switzerland, on **June 24, 2019.**
 
• Italy has previously hosted three Olympic Games: the 2006 Winter Olympics in Turin, the 1956 Winter Olympics in Cortina d'Ampezzo, and the 1960 Summer Olympics in Rome.
 
• Milano-Cortina 2026 marks the fourth occasion of Italy hosting the Olympics. Notably, it will be the first Olympic Games officially featuring multiple host cities and the first Winter Olympics since Sarajevo 1984 to hold the opening and closing ceremonies in different venues.
 
• Additionally, events will be held in seven other cities situated in the north-northeastern region of Italy.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The upcoming games will commemorate several significant milestones: the **20th anniversary of the Winter Olympics** in Turin, the 70th anniversary of the Winter Olympics in Cortina d'Ampezzo, and the debut of Milan as a host city for the Olympic Games.
 
• The final candidates for the official anthem of the event were unveiled during the **Sanremo Music Festival 2022** finals, with a subsequent poll allowing audiences to participate in selecting the chosen anthem.
